title: WORLD MARKERS SHARE ONE LABEL STYLE
why: The critic on the separated cache and extraction marker pictures found different type sizes and panel styles. Both now use the shared graphite panel, cream 16px labels and 32px minimum height at 1080p, doubled at 4K. The exit arrow stays teal and the two destinations keep separate markers. Watch: the cache name and extraction distance should remain easy to tell apart and never overprint; enemy names and health pips still stack. Only rendering changes.
now: Cache and extraction markers share one readable label size and panel style. The exit arrow stays teal.
